inflate the review-round counter. Plan v3 instead designs INDEPENDENT batches that
each land separately, each with its own probe/claim/pin/verify/commit/release
protocol. Each batch is therefore its own round.

intermediate-unit marker suppression no longer applies to it: it posts `epm:results`
with the canonical four H3 sections plus the `## Smoke run` H2, because the
code-review ensemble's mechanical contract keys on that marker and a missing one
manufactures a `marker-shape` blocker (#2248). Within a batch that is itself
